business_objective: Verify role-based sign-in and session behavior
steps: Sign in with each role; sign out; attempt access after sign-out
expected_outcome: Each role reaches only its permitted modules; signed-out session is rejected

business_objective: Find a building by Arabic name
preconditions: Arabic-named buildings exist in pilot data
steps: Switch to Arabic; search by Arabic name; open the building
expected_outcome: Correct building found; detail drawer shows Arabic name and legacy code

steps: Filter by governorate; page forward and back; sort by name
expected_outcome: Counts match the server total; pages do not overlap or skip

preconditions: Buildings qualified for at least 2 governorates
steps: Open Geographic Intelligence; compare a governorate count with the School Map filter
expected_outcome: Counts agree between map and register; coverage denominator is 27

business_objective: Record an allocation and read execution
steps: Create an allocation; record execution; open the finance report
expected_outcome: Figures reconcile exactly (decimal); report totals match entries

business_objective: Confirm finance figures are hidden from non-finance roles
steps: Open the Portfolio Overview as a technical operator
expected_outcome: No EGP figures are present in the payload or the screen

business_objective: Walk a tender through its lifecycle
steps: Advance the tender stage by stage to contracted
expected_outcome: All 12 stages traversed in order; each transition audited

steps: Attempt to move a draft directly to awarded
expected_outcome: Refused with a clear message; stage unchanged

steps: Filter by one stage; search by title fragment
expected_outcome: Only matching tenders listed; total reflects the filter

business_objective: Value a certificate from item lines
steps: Create a certificate with 2 item lines; read the total
expected_outcome: Total equals qty x price summed exactly per line

steps: As certifier A attempt payment authorization; as finance B authorize
expected_outcome: A is refused; B succeeds; both attempts audited

business_objective: Create an estimate and revise it
steps: Create estimate; add items; save a revision; open history
expected_outcome: Revisions listed with timestamps and authors

steps: Attempt progression to REMV02 before recording a decree; then record the decree and progress
expected_outcome: First attempt refused; after decree recorded progression succeeds

steps: Download the finance CSV; compare totals with the screen
expected_outcome: CSV totals match the screen exactly

steps: Create a user; deactivate it; attempt sign-in as that user
expected_outcome: Deactivated user cannot sign in; actions audited

steps: Open the batch reconciliation; read the three outcome columns
expected_outcome: Technical outcome shown separately from business equivalence and acceptance (both PENDING until GAEB acts)

steps: Open rejects; read reasons and raw evidence
expected_outcome: Every quarantined record carries a reason and raw-hex evidence

business_objective: Approve and revoke a mapping approval
steps: Grant an approval with an evidence reference; revoke it with a reason
expected_outcome: Approval binds to the transform version; revocation is recorded with its reason

business_objective: Complete one full workflow in Arabic
steps: Execute the tender lifecycle entirely in Arabic
expected_outcome: All labels and messages Arabic; identifiers remain Latin; layout mirrors correctly

steps: Import the corrupted extract; read the outcome
expected_outcome: Valid records load; invalid records quarantine with reasons; nothing is silently lost
